name: Gallery
description: The pictures worth keeping, shown again: a picture a paid service drew (a Generated Image, a Weather Visualizer) is kept here as it is drawn, so it can be shown many times for what it cost once. The oldest unpinned pictures go when the limits below are reached. Not part of a backup.

properties.name: maxPictures
properties.title: Most Pictures
properties.description: The most pictures the Gallery keeps. When there are more, the oldest one that is not pinned goes first.

properties.name: maxMB
properties.title: Pool Size
properties.description: The most disk the Gallery's pictures may use. When it is full, the oldest one that is not pinned goes first.

properties.name: order
properties.title: Order
properties.description: The order of the pictures in the list. A Slide Show shows the list through before it asks again.

properties.name: pinnedOnly
properties.title: Pinned Only
properties.description: Show only the pictures you pinned.
